name: CWComplex.mapsTo
statement: ℕ) (i : cell C n) : ∃ I : Π m, Finset (cell C m), MapsTo (map n i) (sphere 0 1) (⋃ (m < n) (j ∈ I m), map m j '' closedBall 0 1)

name: CWComplex.union
statement: ⋃ (n : ℕ) (j : cell C n), closedCell n j = C

name: CWComplex.closed
statement: Set X) [CWComplex C] [T2Space X] (A : Set X) (asubc : A ⊆ C) : IsClosed A ↔ ∀ n (j : cell C n), IsClosed (A ∩ closedCell n j)
